# Camp Resource: Deep Water Well

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 13, 2024
- 1 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0b295c795c5f4d85b4d1b12fedd8bed9~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Drink deep! This Deep Well will dispense non-radiated water to keep your C.A.M.P. free from thirst.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Deep Water Well__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_75f347a769a8473ea71884b00f839047~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Purified Water

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Water

**Holds**

2 Purified Water

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Deep Water Well Collector__ - 500 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

4 minutes and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Thanks for your support!
